subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Does the secops/workflow ownership group approve these executable action replacements on the final rebased head after completing the required Codex and upstream contract checks?
rationale: Several actions execute with secrets, mint tokens, publish artifacts, or process security results, and ordinary green CI cannot establish that those trust-boundary changes match maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the verified exact head
options.body: Complete secops and Codex contract review, rebase once, and merge only when all required checks pass for that unchanged head.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex-agent upgrades into narrower owner-reviewed pull requests.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Wait until Dependabot repository access and rebasing stabilize before spending further owner-review effort.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified exact head
recommendation.body: Complete secops and Codex contract review, rebase once, and merge only when all required checks pass for that unchanged head.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns several changed security workflows to this team, making it the strongest available trust-boundary decision owner.
